<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-component-api.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Renders one chat message. User messages are right-aligned bubbles; assistant messages render text as markdown, reasoning and tool parts inline, file parts as thumbnails/chips, and a hover action row (copy / regenerate).

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/chat/Message.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { Message } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/chat";
```
